tse_deployer.name: TSE Deployer
tse_deployer.restart_cmd: pm2 delete tse-lead-gen-api || true; pm2 delete tse-deployer || true; pm2 start ../../server.js --name tse-deployer

tse_lead_gen.name: TSE Lead Gen
tse_lead_gen.build_cmd: npm run build && cd server && npm install
tse_lead_gen.restart_cmd: cp ../../server/.env ./server/.env || true; rm -rf ../../dist && cp -r dist ../../dist && rm -rf ../../server && cp -r server ../../server && cp version.json ../../version.json || true; pm2 delete lead-gen-api || true; pm2 start ../../server/server.js --name lead-gen-api

tse_audit_engine.name: TSE Site Audit Engine
tse_audit_engine.build_cmd: npm run build && cd server && npm install
tse_audit_engine.restart_cmd: cp ../../server/.env ./server/.env || true; rm -rf ../../dist && cp -r dist ../../dist && rm -rf ../../server && cp -r server ../../server && cp version.json ../../version.json || true; pm2 delete tse-audit-engine-api || true; pm2 start /var/www/www-root/data/www/audit-dev.thesearchequation.co.uk/server/server.js --name tse-audit-engine-api --cwd /var/www/www-root/data/www/audit-dev.thesearchequation.co.uk/server

tse_website_manager_api.name: TSE Website Manager API
tse_website_manager_api.restart_cmd: mkdir -p /var/www/www-root/data/www/api-website-manager.thesearchequation.co.uk/shared_db; pm2 delete website-manager-api || true; PERSISTENT_STORAGE_DIR=/var/www/www-root/data/www/api-website-manager.thesearchequation.co.uk/shared_db PORT=3005 pm2 start server/index.js --name website-manager-api --cwd /var/www/www-root/data/www/api-website-manager.thesearchequation.co.uk/current
